decisions.reason: Tightening paragraph and section spacing for page-limit compliance does not change Canva access, ownership, or asset-policy requirements.
The spacing adjustment does not change the requirement that hyperlinks remain functional in the final PDF.
The source concerns layout compression for the current proposal and does not resume or alter the deferred reusable-template requirement.
Reducing document spacing does not change the required PDF count, email submission method, compatibility, or export quality.
The same-message layout Event already records tightened paragraph and section spacing, so no additional or corrected MODIFY is required.
The source's separate instruction to condense the first-page letter to one page is already captured by the same-message INTRODUCE for this Requirement.
The page-spacing decision does not change the approved photo source, mandatory selections, or photo-placement requirement.
The spacing adjustment does not change which tables must be integrated or the approved source for the revised tables.
The source does not alter the Blue Mesa Strategies identity, logo, or color requirements.
Paragraph and section spacing is distinct from the existing font-type and font-size consistency rules, which remain unchanged.
The document-spacing change does not alter the biography count, affiliation, insertion method, or content source.
Tightening spacing and condensing the cover letter do not authorize section reordering or change the required skeleton order.
